rv.q: His willingness to allow his insecurities and awkwardness to stand in as the butt of these jokes is what elevates the show to a higher form of gallows humor.
Birbiglia's delivery remains deliciously dry and deadpan, with offhand observations on even the smallest details.
The Old Man and the Pool is everything we've come to love from Birbiglia, a wonderful and winding narrative based in his own life that is equally engaging and contemplative...
Sometimes he succeeds and sometimes he doesn’t, depending on your expectations and your sense of humor.

cn.t: Birbiglia's meditation on mortality earns mostly positive reviews for its humor and storytelling, though reception is mixed on how successfully he balances comedy with heavier themes of death and aging.
